Plugin.Name: Flotilla Agent
Plugin.Overview:
Flotilla Agent sends the notifications from your Unraid server to the Flotilla app on your iPhone. Flotilla is a free iOS app for Unraid and Proxmox. Push notifications need Flotilla Pro. Flotilla Pro costs USD 4.99 one time. Get the app from the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794414215
The plugin adds an Unraid notification agent. It sends the notifications that Unraid makes, for example parity checks, disk errors, SMART warnings and array events. Your User Scripts can also send notifications with the notify command. On the settings page, you can select all notifications, only warnings and alerts, or only alerts.
After you pair a phone, the plugin sends a heartbeat signal every minute. If the signals stop, the phone gets a Server unreachable alert.
The plugin also runs three server checks: mover schedule, share free space, and disk load cycles. A problem creates an Unraid notification. The checks also operate when you have not paired a phone. The checks read only saved status files. They do not wake disks. To stop the checks, set Run server checks to No and click Save.
The plugin encrypts the content of each event on your server with ChaCha20-Poly1305. The encryption occurs before the data goes out of your local network. The key is in two locations only: the configuration file on your server, and the keychain on the paired phone. The relay that sends the push message receives ciphertext only. The plugin does not send your Unraid API key, your host name, or other local secrets.
The plugin is free and open source. The settings page is at Settings, then Flotilla Agent. You pair the phone with a QR code.
Plugin.Requires: To get push notifications, you need the Flotilla app on your iPhone. The app is free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794414215 Push notifications need Flotilla Pro. Flotilla Pro costs USD 4.99 one time.
